cohort_selection_rule: Twenty-four bounded, source-adapter-shaped cases selected to cover every F2F lifecycle outcome, PFRA binding states, attribution grains, finance-only negative controls, and scoped non-findings. These are regression fixtures, not production acquisitions or prevalence estimates.
evidence_universe: Each case contains one governed source-adapter output; no prose classification, source retrieval, subject resolution, or financial allocation is performed by the runner.
residual_gaps: Fixture cohort exercises typed adapter outputs only; it does not establish real-world prevalence.
No source-supported share or bounds fixture is available, so no share/bounds metric is promoted.
Organisation-level financial observations remain explicitly unattributed to a practice, campaign, or provider.
